description: He wears a long burgundy outer robe with broad gold and dark geometric embroidered bands around the open front, cuffs and hem. Beneath it is an ivory long-sleeved tunic with a narrow decorated collar, vertical front trim and embroidered cuffs and lower border. A dark belt edged with geometric gold embroidery has a round bronze-colored buckle and a long hanging decorated strap. Dark trousers are tucked into calf-high dark brown leather boots with ankle straps and modest heels.
